to_angular_frequency.doc: Convert frequency to angular frequency: omega = 2·pi·f. Radian-primary: omega is the fundamental quantity.

to_frequency.doc: Convert angular frequency to frequency: f = omega / (2·pi).

to_radian_phase.doc: Convert a phase in cycles [0, 1] to radians [0, 2·pi]. One cycle is 2·pi radians.

to_cycle_phase.doc: Convert a phase in radians to cycles [0, 1].

apply_lagrangian_norm.doc: Apply the (2/pi) normalisation to a Lagrangian term.

inversion_transform.doc:
Apply the (I|O) inversion (r, theta) -> (1/r, theta + pi/2).

This is the 2-stroke engine's compression stroke. Radian-primary.

inversion_involution.doc:
Apply the (I|O) inversion twice and check that it returns to the start.

Verifies that the 2-stroke engine completes its cycle.
inversion_involution.returns: ((r_final, theta_final), holds) where holds is True if the involution holds

ratio_to_fraction.doc: Return an interval ratio as an exact Fraction. Use throughout the sonification pipeline; convert to float only at the final render.

fraction_to_float.doc: Convert a Fraction ratio to a float at the render boundary. This is the ONLY place float conversion should occur in the sonification pipeline.

algebra_to_radian_depth.doc:
Return the radian-depth of an algebra layer: log2(dim) · (pi/2), so each doubling adds pi/2 of phase.

This is the algebraic time coordinate (not BPM).

raises.ValueError: algebra_name is not a known layer
